verdict.rationale: Anytype documents linking between Objects as the basis of a connected knowledge base, says you can trace how ideas relate and see what connects to a project, and offers a live Graph of how Objects connect. That covers basic inter-note linking and a visual view of connections only. Nothing in the evidence shows the specific researcher workflow of wiki-style links with in-context backlinks and unlinked mentions. Missing for 10: documented [[wiki-style]] link syntax, a backlinks panel showing linking context, unlinked-mention detection, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
